newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers softer on ample supplies.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers softer on ample supplies.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were quoted slighly lower but buyers still held back for lower prices amid sufficient supplies, traders said on Friday.
"There are still not many enquiries today. Some sellers are nervous now after recent crude falls," said one major.
Many shipowners are holding back orders expecting further price cuts after Singapore's Trade Development Board data showed stocks at nine-month high of 12.299 million barrels.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $98-$99 per tonne and 180-cst at $105-$106. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $186-$190 and $200-$205 respectively. - Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
